description_en: Attaches a system policy or custom policy to a DMS user or custom role
description_zh: 调用此API可以给DMS用户或自定义角色授予策略权限，包含系统权限策略和自定义权限策略
name: CreateAbacAuthorization

parameters.help_en:
Principal Type. Valid values:userorcustom role.

Valid values:

USER
ROLE
parameters.help_zh: 授权对象类型，支持选择用户或自定义角色
parameters.name: identity_type

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the user. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/465816.html operation to query the user ID.

If IdentityType is set to USER, this parameter is required
parameters.help_zh:
用户ID。您可通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/465816.html接口获取该参数的值。
当IdentityType参数的值选择USER时需要填写
parameters.name: user_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the role.

If IdentityType is set to ROLE, this parameter is required
parameters.help_zh:
角色ID。

当IdentityType参数的值选择ROLE时需要填写
parameters.name: role_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the tenant.

To view the ID of the tenant, go to the Data Management (DMS) console and move the pointer over the profile picture in the upper-right corner. For more information, see the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/181330.html section of the "Manage DMS tenants" topic
parameters.help_zh:
租户ID。
取自系统右上角头像处悬停展示的租户ID信息，详情请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/181330.html
parameters.name: tid

RequestId.description_en: The request ID. You can use the request ID to query logs and troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 请求ID。请求的唯一标识，用于定位日志，排查问题

Result.description_en: Indicates whether the policy is attached
Result.description_zh: 权限策略授权是否成功

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request was successful. Valid values:

true: The request succeeded.
false: The request failed
Success.description_zh:
请求是否成功，返回值如下：
true：请求成功。
false：请求失败
